function.name: get_outline
function.description: List the document's paragraphs in order: id, style, length in characters and the first 100 characters of text. Call again after inserting or deleting paragraphs.

function.name: read_range
function.description: Return the full text, style and character formatting (bold/italic/underline spans) of the given paragraphs.

ids.description: Paragraph ids from get_outline or find, at most 50.

function.name: find
function.description: Find literal text in the document. Returns up to 50 matches with paragraph id, start offset and surrounding context.

function.name: replace_text
function.description: Replace text. With id and find: replace every exact, case-sensitive occurrence of find in that paragraph. With find only: replace it in the whole document. With id only: replace the paragraph's entire text (use for rewriting or translating a paragraph). Formatting of the replaced text is kept where possible.

id.description: Paragraph id. Omit to replace in the whole document.

find.description: Exact text to replace. Omit to replace the whole paragraph.

replace.description: New text. May be empty to remove the found text.

function.name: insert_paragraphs
function.description: Insert new paragraphs after the paragraph with id after_id (0 inserts at the beginning of the document). Returns the new ids.

after_id.description: Existing paragraph id, or 0 for the start.

function.name: set_paragraph_style
function.description: Set the style of whole paragraphs. Consecutive paragraphs set to the same list style form one list.

function.name: apply_text_style
function.description: Turn bold, italic or underline on (true) or off (false). With find: applies to every occurrence of that text, in the given paragraphs or, if ids is omitted, in the whole document. Without find: applies to the whole text of the given paragraphs. Returns the number of spans changed.
